turns.speaker: Barista
turns.en: Hi! What can I get for you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Hi. Can I have a large iced latte, please?
turns.ko: 안녕하세요. 라지 아이스 라떼 한 잔 주세요.

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.en: Sure. Would you like any flavor in that?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Vanilla, please. And can I also get a blueberry muffin?
turns.ko: 바닐라 주세요. 그리고 블루베리 머핀도 하나 주세요.

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.en: Of course. For here or to go?

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.en: That'll be eight dollars and fifty cents.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Here you go. Can I pay by card?

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.en: Yes. Please tap your card here. Your order number is thirty-two.
turns.ko: 네. 이곳에 카드 대주세요. 주문 번호는 32번입니다.
